content.short: Flipside enables community members to create and share data insights on crypto projects.
content.description: Flipside provides community-enabled crypto analytics, enabling users to create and share data insights on crypto projects they care about. It also enables thousands of analysts to learn, collaborate, and compete to solve analytical challenges through structured bounty programs using a free, open data platform.
content.meta: Flipside offers community crypto analytics to share insights on crypto projects. Discover Flipside and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
